verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Intel serves a working llms.txt (HTTP 200) with company/AI-compute description, and additional docs cite content pulled from llms-full.txt, showing agent-oriented documentation is genuinely available for agents to consume. Missing for 10: product-specific (rather than corporate-wide) llms.txt content for the 258V SKU, and independent third-party corroboration that agents successfully use it.
